This is a mid-to-senior full-stack role (Software Engineer II) on Smartsheet's work-management and collaboration platform, covering features end-to-end from front end through back end, data modeling, and infrastructure. The work centers on high-performance virtualized views rendering hundreds of thousands of rows, plus distributed back-end systems, APIs, and data pipelines for real-time collaboration and high-concurrency workloads. The core stack is TypeScript/JavaScript with React and Redux on the client, and server-side languages such as Java, Python, Ruby, or Go running on cloud infrastructure in a service-oriented architecture.
